name: Enemy Compendium
description: The enemy compendium, instances, encounters, combat and discovery — the subsystem that used to live in core, now a bundled mod that ships on by default. Its five tables adopt the five retired .enemy*.json campaign files once, on first open, so a campaign created before the extraction opens with its monsters and its owner notices nothing (Phase 8.5). Phase 8.3 — the enemy subsystem's prompt block, Ask-GM sections, budget claim, tier entry and inCombat fact, owned by the mod. The block lands at contribution order ~150 in the final user message (immediately after the composed volatile block, before the first directive built-in at 200) — the closest reachable position to the segment's pre-8.3 order 300. The interceptor fires once per turn; its output is reused verbatim by any swipe or continuation of that turn (MODDING.md). The tier entry (mod.enemies.enemyDiscovery) gates the discovery scan at lite/pro/max as the built-in MATRIX rows did. Native-tier only — the tokenizer, the interceptor and the budget claim are all native-tier surfaces.
author: Narrative Engine
